ENPTES
R-01 · Reflections 02 of 06

A looping form twists through itself, creating unstable spatial tension. Its surface behaves like reflection, distorting the surrounding field. The dark patterned ground is bent and reinterpreted, preventing a fixed viewpoint and keeping perception in constant adjustment.
